geography: Worldwide (J&J WW row: US + Intl; line OLYSIO/SOVRIAD)

approval_evidence.quote: 11/22/2013 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY (NDA 205123, OLYSIO)

launch_evidence.quote: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted approval of OLYSIO ™ (simeprevir) for combination treatment of chronic hepatitis C.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the 2013Q4 launch quarter. The 2013Q4 release prints no OLYSIO line; its quarter (23) is read from the prior-year column of the 2014Q4 schedule.
series_end_reason: The 2017Q1 Exhibit 99.2 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040617000020/a8k2017q1exhibit992o.htm) prints the infectious-disease lines 'EDURANT / RILPIVIRINE', 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA', 'OTHER INFECTIOUS DISEASES' and no OLYSIO line (the word does not appear in any 2017Q1-2026Q3 exhibit); the last OLYSIO quarter is 2016Q4 (OLYSIO / SOVRIAD WW 10 vs 44).
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 200406 (Johnson & Johnson) from data.sec.gov/submissions including the older 'files' pages (all forms). Earnings 8-Ks: the quarter->Exhibit 99.2 map was taken for 2008Q1-2026Q3 from 8-Ks with item 2.02 (and, before item codes, 8-Ks whose exhibits print a product schedule with WW rows); 2010Q2, 2010Q4, 2011Q2 and 2011Q3 were added by reading those 8-Ks' index.json (exhibit992o.htm, exhibit99152o4thqtr2010.htm, ninetyninetwoo.htm, exhibit992o3rdqtr2011.htm). All 75 exhibits were fetched in this run and each was checked to print 'Dollars in Millions'.

Each exhibit was parsed table by table: a single-cell row is a product line, the US / Intl / WW rows beneath it are its regions; the WW row is recorded. The first occurrence of a product in an exhibit is the quarter table (the quarter table precedes the six/nine/twelve-month table; confirmed against each table's own QUARTER vs MONTHS header where the header is in the table). A quarter whose own release prints no line for the product is read from the prior-year (second) column of the release a year later (derivation direct_prior_year_column).
Also scanned every 10-K and 10-Q primary document filed from 2013-04 to 2026-10 for the brand names (none prints a sales figure for these brands).
